questions.question:
In the following question, select the related word from the given alternatives.

Pressure : Barometer :: ? : Odometer
questions.solution:
Just as we use barometer to measure pressure, similarly odometer is used to measure distance.

Hence, answer is Distance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The **hygrometer** is an instrument used to measure humidity to find the quantity of water vapor in the air, in soil, or in enclosed spaces.
 
• A **vernier caliper** is a high-precision measurement tool that can be used in multiple types of measurements. It can measure thickness, diameter and even inside diameter for pipes. 
 
• An **anemometer** is an instrument that measures wind speed and wind pressure.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the related letters from the given alternatives.

AEDM : ZQRN :: FLMO : ?
questions.solution:
A + 13 = N; E + 13 = R; D + 13 = Q; M + 13 = Z

Now NRQZ is written in reverse order that is ZQRN.

Similarly, F + 13 = S; L + 13 = Y; M + 13 = Z; O + 13 = B

SYZB is written in reverse order, that is BZYS.

Hence, answer is BZYS.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd letters from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
1) CEAC → C + 2 = E; E – 4 = A; A + 2 = C

2) FHDF → F + 2 = H; H – 4 = D; D + 2 = F

3) PRMP → P + 2 = R; R **– 5** = M; M **+ 3** = P

4) TVRT → T + 2 = V; V – 4 = R; R + 2 = T

Therefore, PRMP is the odd one out.

questions.question: In a class, P has more marks than Q and R does not have the least marks. S has more marks than T and T has more marks than P, who among them will have the least marks?
questions.solution:
Given,

P > Q

R does not have least marks.

S > T, T > P

⇒ S > T > P > Q

⇒ Q has the least marks.

questions.question:
In the following question, from the given alternative words, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word.

**RECIPROCATE**
questions.solution:
1) PROCEED → RECIPROCATE → cannot be formed as there is no letter **D**.

2) RACE → **REC**IPROC**A**TE → can be formed.

3) REPEAT → **RE**CI**P**ROC**ATE** → can be formed.

4) TEAR → RECIP**R**OC**ATE** → can be formed.

The word ‘Proceed’ cannot be formed by using the letters of the word ‘Reciprocate’ because the letter ‘D’ is missing in the given letter.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the number which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20c25c127008ab0b3da922493cbe3cf9dd9f4e5d6e0d19340323b436970620fd.png]
questions.solution:
**Sum of surrounding number = product of digits of central number**

5 + 6 + 7 + 9 = 27 = 9 × 3 

8 + 9 + 7 + 6 = 30 = 6 × 5 

Similarly,

**x + 3 + 6 + 5 = 6 × 3 = 18**

**⇒ × + 14 = 18**

**⇒ × = 4**

Hence, missing number is 4.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some staplers are pins.

All pins are markers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some staplers are markers.

II. All markers are pins.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c55e3bb5204d42fbfe0cc1707f4824ab9b6dc1c657ecc6a13c42b6ae987959aa.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some staplers are markers → True.

II. All markers are pins → False.

Thus, only conclusion I follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a27f10715bcbe2e200110724fa0199ee1ba71fbc548f29b967bb63438e110217.png]
questions.solution:
The four sides adjacent to face containing ‘5’ are ‘4’, ‘2’, ‘1’, ‘6’. Also ‘4’ and ‘2’ & ‘6’ and ‘1’ are adjacent.
